notes.title: Shong Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Shong has officially released![/h1]


[h2]Patch Notes for v1.2.1[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 29 steam achievements including 8 hidden achievements! Can you find them all?
[*] Added match replay feature. The last five games are now recorded to %appdata%/Shong/Replay. These matches  can be viewed in the game via Main Menu -> Play -> Replay. Use the left/right arrows to navigate forward/backward through the match history.
[/list]
